title: XML External Entity Injection in simplexml
platform_conditions: PHP 7.4/8.x linked against libxml2; external entity loading is disabled by default in libxml2 >= 2.9, so LIBXML_NOENT mainly re-enables substitution — verify the linked libxml version before judging exploitability
security_mechanism: Passing LIBXML_NOENT makes the parser substitute entity definitions while parsing: with libxml2 builds where external entity loading is enabled (< 2.9 behavior, or explicit flags), a DTD can declare entities that resolve to file:// or http:// targets, embedding local files into the document or issuing outbound requests. Independent of external loading, recursive entity definitions enable billion-laughs amplification that exhausts memory on one request. SoapClient fetches and parses the WSDL URL passed to its constructor, making it an SSRF primitive when that URL is request-derived, and curl honors many protocols (file://, dict://, ftp://) and follows redirects when CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION is set, so a URL allowlist without CURLOPT_PROTOCOLS/CURLOPT_REDIR_PROTOCOLS pins is insufficient.

source_sink_clues.source: Client-posted XML documents, WSDL/endpoint URLs from requests, and outbound fetch URLs.
source_sink_clues.sink: simplexml_load_string / DOMDocument::loadXML with LIBXML_NOENT; SoapClient constructed with an input URL; curl transfers with input URLs and unrestricted protocol/redirect options

tracking_guards: Require that untrusted XML is parsed without LIBXML_NOENT (keep LIBXML_NONET, restrict DTD processing) and check the linked libxml2 version; require SoapClient URLs to come from configuration; require curl with CURLOPT_PROTOCOLS limited to https/http and CURLOPT_REDIR_PROTOCOLS set before any redirect following.
not_candidate_when: The XML originates from trusted internal producers that emit no DTDs and LIBXML_NOENT is absent, the linked libxml2 is >= 2.9 with external loading disabled and expansion depth is bounded, or curl targets are allowlisted https hosts with protocols and redirects pinned by option.
public_references: CWE-611: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference — https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/611.html
CWE-776: Improper Restriction of Recursive Entity References in DTDs — https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/776.html
